name: Default Processing Or Standing Instruction 2 Choice
definition: Choice between default processing or standing instruction.

DefaultOptionIndicator.name: Default Option Indicator
DefaultOptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the option, for example, currency option, will be selected by default if no instruction is provided by the account owner.

StandingInstructionIndicator.name: Standing Instruction Indicator
StandingInstructionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an account owner has placed a standing order to select this corporate action option.|The standing instruction may or may not be overridden, depending on account or event terms.
